statements.status_notes: The finding is attributed to the rpm source package through the installed librpm10/librpmio10 libraries. The vulnerable code is in tools/rpmuncompress.c, the same component as CVE-2026-84233, shipped by Debian only in the rpm binary package as /usr/lib/rpm/rpmuncompress. Neither the runtime image nor the fixed-appliance package set installs the rpm binary package, so the vulnerable executable and invocation path are absent. Debian records the issue as no-dsa for trixie and Red Hat Bugzilla 2462222 currently lists no fixed version.

The finding is attributed to the rpm source package through the installed librpm10/librpmio10 libraries. The vulnerable code is in rpmbuild's -t tarball handling, shipped by Debian only in the rpm binary package as /usr/bin/rpmbuild. Neither the runtime image nor the fixed-appliance package set installs the rpm binary package, and librpmbuild10 is not installed either, so the vulnerable executable and invocation path are absent. This image runs no rpm build workflow. Debian records the issue as no-dsa for trixie and Red Hat Bugzilla 2478408 currently lists no fixed version.

Debian trixie rpm 4.20.1+dfsg-3 is vulnerable to rpmbuild getTarSpec() macro injection via crafted tar member names (CVE-2026-78367; upstream issue rpm-software-management/rpm#4314). Applied package/deb/main/rpm/patch/CVE-2026-78367.patch to use POSIX basename(3) instead of rpmExpand(%{basename:tarbuf}) when renaming extracted spec files.

NVD lists rpm 4.13.0.2 and 4.14.0 as affected; Red Hat bugzilla 1452133 records Fixed In Version rpm-4.13.0.2 for predictable temporary filenames during RPM installation. This package builds rpm 4.20.1+dfsg-3+dhi0, which is newer than the fixed 4.13.0.2 release.

NVD CPE lists affected rpm versions from 4.13.0.0 up to (excluding) 4.13.0.2. Red Hat bugzilla 1450369 records Fixed In Version rpm-4.13.0.2; upstream commits c815822c8bdb and f2d3be2a8741 address symlink handling during installation. This package builds rpm 4.20.1+dfsg-3+dhi0, which includes the 4.13.0.2 fix.

NVD describes lib/fsm.c metadata reset during RPM package upgrade or removal in RPM 4.8.0 and earlier. Upstream fixed the related CVE-2010-2059 flaw in rpm 4.8.1 (commit 4d172a194addc49851e558ea390d3045894e3230); Debian has shipped rpm >= 4.8.1-1 since. This package builds rpm 4.20.1+dfsg-3+dhi0, so the vulnerable 4.8.0-and-earlier code is not present.
